name: Nuoc mam chat
summary: Nước mắm chắt is the fish sauce the Xuân Thủy national park route places at Giao Hải, made from the local catch. The route says a visitor can taste it. A grade was not printed. Nước mắm Sa Châu is a different name. A price is Check on arrival.
origin: Giao Hải, on the coastal day inside the Xuân Thủy visit. Vườn quốc gia Xuân Thủy.
howToEat: As a condiment, not a bowl, on the coastal day. A grade and a price are Check on arrival.
where: Giao Hải. It is not the Sa Châu gift on the Báo Nam Định list.
seoTitle: Nuoc mam chat — Giao Hai fish sauce
seoDescription: Fish sauce at Giao Hải on the Xuân Thủy route, tasted on the coastal day. A grade and a price are Check on arrival.
